fieldNotes.location: Roster address (5111 Fairway Ave) and geocode landed in a residential neighborhood — wrong. Skippy Foods is at 8201 Frazier Pike, at the Port of Little Rock (confirmed by Hormel/Little Rock Chamber/ADEQ). Resolved to 34.7079,-92.1843 — the 'Skippy' logo is visible on the building tower in 2026 Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully enclosed by chain-link perimeter fence. The truck entrance off Frazier Pike (a long paved/gravel driveway on the SE) passes through a chain-link sliding gate at the fence opening near the building yard (gate rail visible in z21 satellite; chain-link gate visible in 2026 Street View). truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth straddling the truck lane was identified — the slide gate appears unstaffed (motorized / badge or remote check-in). Flagged uncertain. remoteGs set true accordingly.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Loop driveway and large paved yard inside the gate give ample holding room before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach driveway from Frazier Pike into the fenced yard easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and broad open yard — physical room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank along the NW building face with a dock canopy and trailers backed in; estimated ~22 doors (10-25 band).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Many trailers parked in rows around the building loop and along the N and E yard — estimated ~45 visible (25-50 band).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer parking rows around the loop drive separate from the active dock face.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property visible despite the port setting.
fieldNotes.note: The plant suffered a fire in September 2025 and returned to operation by December 2025; 2026 Street View shows it intact and operating.
